lg.$description: Page-level headlines (text/display-md). 40px on narrow screens, 64px on wide.

xl.$description: The largest size, for hero headlines (text/display-lg). 64px on narrow screens, 104px on wide.

sm.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/sm: a 28px line on 24px text.

md.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/md: a 44px line on 40px text.

lg.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/lg: a 44px line on 40px text on narrow screens, a 64px line on 64px text on wide.

xl.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/xl: a 64px line on 64px text on narrow screens, a 104px line on 104px text on wide.

sm.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/sm: about -0.01em, since larger text needs tighter tracking to hold together.

md.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/md: about -0.0125em, since larger text needs tighter tracking to hold together.

lg.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/lg: about -0.0125em on narrow screens and -0.02em on wide, since larger text needs tighter tracking to hold together.

xl.$description: Pairs with font-size/display/xl: about -0.02em on narrow screens and -0.025em on wide, since larger text needs tighter tracking to hold together.
